inlines.v: CONCISION, noun [Latin , to cut off.] Literally, a cutting off. Hence, In scripture, the Jews or those who adhered to circumcision, which, after our Savior's death, was no longer a seal of the covenant, but a mere cutting of the flesh. Beware of dogs; beware of the concision Philippians 3:2.
